name: Sepulcher Cloisters
introDiscord:
The royal memorial gardens are quiet, elegant, and covered in carved
statues honoring people whose names the sea has nearly erased.

Sepulcher Mantas glide between them like enormous ceremonial ribbons.
introTwitch:
The royal memorial gardens are quiet, elegant, and covered in carved
statues honoring people whose names the sea has nearly erased.

Sepulcher Mantas glide between them like enormous ceremonial ribbons.

sepulcher-cloisters-approach.prompt: Sepulcher Cloisters opens into three routes through the drowned kingdom.

left.message: A memorial offering chest contains Star Candies beneath faded flowers.

right.message: A Sepulcher Manta sweeps between the statues.

forward.message:
A calm memorial fountain restores strength.

Shizuki wrote:

'Quiet place.

Glimmer stopped chiming.

We stayed awhile.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

sepulcher-cloisters-depths.prompt: Deeper within Sepulcher Cloisters, three paths wind through the abandoned royal district.

left.message: A Manta glides beneath the carved arches.

right.message: A family memorial box contains old offerings and Star Candies.

forward.message:
One Berry rests beneath Shizuki's tiny note:

'Leaving this for whoever visits next.

Eat it somewhere nice.'

sepulcher-cloisters-threshold.prompt: Near Royal Crypt Nave, three final approaches lead onward.

left.message: A mineral spring trickles through the memorial stone.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message: A Sepulcher Manta circles the crypt entrance.

forward.message:
An old ceremonial casket contains no remains—only offerings and Star
Candies.

boss-antechamber.name: Royal Crypt Nave
boss-antechamber.prompt: Inside Royal Crypt Nave, the memorial ribbons rise.

peace.

bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Royal Crypt Nave. The royal challenge will wait.
completionText:
The Manta disappears between the memorial statues.

Nothing here celebrates death.

It remembers lives.
